capabilities: Render smiles and smarts code blocks as chemical structures
Draw multiple labelled molecules side by side in one block
Mark SMARTS substructure constraints on atoms and bonds
Toggle blocks between structures and source strings with a button
Style blocks with caption, alignment, alt text and CSS class options
extras: Works entirely offline with no network access or data collection; drawing is done on-device via a bundled engine (OpenChemLib, with third-party licenses listed). Includes troubleshooting guidance, a configurable depiction timeout, and developer-console debug logging.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn chemical notation like SMILES strings into drawn molecular structures inside notes.
summary: Renders SMILES and SMARTS code blocks as chemical structure images in Reading view, Live Preview, Canvas, hover previews and exported PDFs.
